vectors.why: Two payments fit, the third does not. The refusal must name what is left.
One unit over the cap is refused even with the whole budget untouched.
amount == cap and spent + amount == budget are both inside the limit, not outside it.
Zero is refused before any cap arithmetic, and the raw string is echoed back.
The host gate runs before the cap gate, so an over-cap amount still reports the host.
payTo is compared case-insensitively but echoed back exactly as the seller sent it.
